summary: pmcro-trail:initialize's link path (an existing --trail-id supplied to orchestrate run) has no deterministic script of its own -- New-Trail.ps1 only implements mint and explicitly rejects an already-existing trail. Orchestrator's New-OrchestrateFrame.ps1 covers claiming/verifying a trail is open and unclaimed, but nothing verifies it was actually materialized by pmcro-trail's own initialize contract. Give pmcro-trail a real link-path script (or an -Link mode on New-Trail.ps1) so that half of its own command contract isn't still aspirational.
resolution_note: Test-TrailLink.ps1 already existed (commit 660b993, predating this queue items status ever being updated), but had a real bug: it hard-required -TrailId even when -TrailPath was supplied directly, contradicting its own docstring and every sibling phase scripts convention. Fixed in trail cff63451-185c-4a61-968a-cc126f5f1481: minimal patch merges the precondition checks to the standard -TrailPath-or-TrailId form and adds task_id to the success output for parity with New-Trail.ps1. Verified against all 5 documented paths (trail-not-found, class-a-unsupported, trail-sealed, trail-linked, success) with real fixtures.
